heroEyebrow: Grace found me in the hospital room
heroHeadline: Finding light in the storm, one healed day at a time
heroSubtext: This is my journal of sickness, surrender, and the slow, faithful love of Christ — written for anyone still waiting on their own miracle.
heroVerseText: "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning."
aboutBio: At twenty-three, a diagnosis I didn't ask for rearranged everything I thought I knew about God, my body, and my future. What began as the hardest season of my life became the place I met Jesus for real — not the Sunday-school version, but the God who sits in the dark with you until morning comes. I share my story here so you know you're not walking through yours alone.
postTitle: The Night I Stopped Bargaining With God
postExcerpt: I used to pray in trades — "heal me and I'll..." — until one night I ran out of things to offer, and found His love had never needed the deal in the first place...
